plan.operation: M31 circle encode and exhaustive output validation
plan.fixture_scope: four nonzero coefficients; value-independent full encoder loops; not random dense coefficients

stages.preparation: allocate and populate original row with independent integer arithmetic
stages.encode: complete public encode call: allocation/copy/zero expansion, inverse normalization, domain/twiddle construction and batch inversions, full forward transform
stages.validation: compare EVERY output with independent integer circle recurrence and polynomial; checksum all outputs

plan.warmup: small release tests and m=8 smoke only, separate process
plan.excluded: process launch, stdout serialization and final buffer deallocation
plan.memory: separate native worker peak RSS per row, including retained input, all internal allocation capacities/overlap, returned output, validation and runtime; Python controller excluded
plan.scope: CPU weight-registration encoding only; no proof, inference, GPU, PCS/profile admission or cost-model fit

Encode stage includes all internal preparation, inverse, expansion, twiddles and forward transform without amortization; fixture construction and exhaustive validation separately timed and included in total. RSS includes all native process capacities/overlap, not isolated scratch or live allocation; no Python controller memory. Standard is a schema tag, not profile certification.
